name: Sales, Use and Value Added Tax
title: Sales, Use and Value Added Tax
answer: Sales, use and value added tax covers the transaction taxes charged on goods and services, as distinct from taxes on income or profit. Sales tax and use tax operate mainly at state and local level in the United States, where a use tax complements a sales tax by reaching purchases on which no sales tax was collected. Value added tax is the equivalent in most other countries, levied at each stage of a supply chain with credits for tax already paid on inputs. The scope for an AI accountant is broad because the rules differ by jurisdiction, by product, and by customer status.

sections.body: Sales, use and value added tax covers the transaction taxes charged on goods and services, as distinct from taxes on income or profit. Sales tax and use tax operate mainly at state and local level in the United States, where a use tax complements a sales tax by reaching purchases on which no sales tax was collected. Value added tax is the equivalent in most other countries, levied at each stage of a supply chain with credits for tax already paid on inputs. The scope for an AI accountant is broad because the rules differ by jurisdiction, by product, and by customer status.
sections.heading: Scope

sections.body: The work runs on tax determination engines and rate and rule databases that map a transaction to the correct jurisdiction and rate. These systems connect to billing, ecommerce and enterprise resource planning platforms so that tax is calculated at the point of sale rather than afterwards. Exemption certificate management and customer tax status records sit alongside them.
sections.heading: What it runs on

sections.body: Practitioners start by classifying what is being sold, since a service, a digital download and a physical good can be treated differently in the same jurisdiction. They then establish where the sale is sourced, which depends on rules about the buyer's location, the seller's location and where the product is used. Registration thresholds, filing calendars and remittance obligations follow from that footprint. Increasingly, machine learning is used to classify products and to flag transactions that fall outside expected patterns, with human review of the exceptions.
sections.heading: How the work is done

sections.body: Rights and risk turn on documentation, because an exemption or a reduced rate is only as good as the certificate or evidence behind it. Provenance matters for automated determinations, since an auditor will want to know which rule version and which rate table produced a figure on a given date. Penalties for undercollection, interest on late remittances and exposure in states where a seller has economic nexus are the main risks.
sections.heading: Rights, risk and provenance

sections.body: The direction of travel is toward real time reporting, with more jurisdictions requiring transaction level data rather than periodic returns. Economic nexus rules have already pushed many remote sellers into registration in states where they have no physical presence. Digital services taxes and the treatment of software as a service continue to be contested across jurisdictions. For AI systems in this area, the practical frontier is keeping rule and rate content current and explaining a determination in terms an auditor will accept.
